critic_risk_flags: Fractional memory is not clearly justified by the series summary (moderate peakiness, short single-season window) and raises overfitting/identifiability risk, especially when combined with an explicit delay (delay vs. memory can trade off in shaping rise/decay and peak timing).

Although H aligns semantically with hospitalization, an explicit H compartment is flagged as weakly identifiable in short single-season series. This adds extra progression/duration parameters that can be unstable with only 31 training points, making delayed_I preferable here.

I+H is poorly aligned to a hospitalization-rate target if the target is admissions-like; it risks level inflation and distorted peak width. It also inherits H identifiability concerns while adding ambiguity in how much signal comes from I vs H, increasing confounding without clear semantic support.
